results.condition:
Build a small playable browser game called Neon Orchard. The player moves a basket horizontally with the arrow keys or A/D to catch falling glowing fruit and avoid falling rocks. Include a score, three lives, increasing difficulty, a start/restart flow, and a polished responsive visual style. Keep it self-contained and runnable in the repository.

Mandatory workflow skills: (none). Before implementing, read every listed skill's `SKILL.md` and follow its instructions for this request. If a listed skill applies to the requested feature or assets, you must use it; do not substitute a generic or procedural workaround when the skill provides the required workflow. For example, when `load-sketchfab-threejs` is listed, use it to obtain and integrate at least one suitable Sketchfab/GLB asset, preserve attribution, and verify that asset renders in the browser. If a listed skill genuinely does not apply, state why in the completion report.

Mandatory orchestration: before declaring the game complete, use OpenCode's `task` tool to launch separate child sessions for:

- builder: implement or improve the game feature;
- critic: independently inspect the current browser result against a concrete named reference and report the single biggest remaining gap;
- verifier: run browser checks and verify the gameplay loop.

Launch independent builder/critic work as parallel background subagents when supported. Wait for all child sessions, apply the critic's concrete finding through an implementation or remediation step, and run verification again afterward. Do not claim a critique loop ran unless the task tool returns distinct child session IDs and the critic produces a concrete finding. If the task tool is unavailable, stop and report the blocker instead of silently doing the work in one agent.
results.evidence: File neon-orchard/index.html (38KB, 993 lines, single self-contained HTML) implements basket catcher with Arrows/A/D + drag + mobile buttons, falling fruit +10 (tiered 10/15/20 via combo) vs rocks -1 life (3 hearts), score/lives HUD with combo xN timer, increasing difficulty (spawn 820→260ms, speedMul 1→2.6, rock rate 22%→40%, double-spawn), start/pause (P/Space)/gameOver/restart flow with best localStorage, neon responsive style, Web Audio, shake/vibrate/particles. Builder ses_fa5267ac3ffe7IWW4jNWsifBv1 created initial game, critic ses_fa5259321ffeBQo6PdYo1vdw5F reported weightless catch (no basket punch/pop/combo/pile), verifier ses_fa5254d76ffe1RLiEI77eMm6IS passed loop checks, remediation added punch (scaleX/Y spring, hitFlash), ring flash + pop scale, combo timer 1.6s tiered scoring + scaled +points xCombo! text, persistent basketPile (12-20 stacked fruits wobbling), re-verifier ses_fa5246c96ffe2Qey4bhyUo8i1g passed 13/13. Mandatory workflow skills: (none) listed — no Sketchfab/asset skill applies to 2D canvas arcade, so no external asset workflow needed. Runnable via file:// or `python -m http.server` at neon-orchard/index.html; node --check syntax PASS, no external deps.
